definition_zh: 补救办法；治疗方法；药物；纠正措施；（法律）救济
definition_en: a treatment that cures or relieves an illness, or a way of correcting a problem or repairing harm
core_image: 手边的一剂药，把失衡的身体或局面重新调回正轨
scene: 山村诊所的药柜几乎空了，老人却还发着高烧。The nurse mixed a simple remedy from honey, lemon and hot water.
sceneCN: 这里 remedy 是「药剂、疗法」（第 1 个义项：缓解病症的药物或疗法）；句意为护士用蜂蜜、柠檬和热水调了一剂简单的药。图中可辨识物件：药柜、陶罐、汤勺。

pos.zh: 名词：药物、疗法；补救办法；法律救济
动词：医治、缓解；纠正、补救

derivatives.zh: 由本词加形容词后缀构成，义为「补救的；治疗上的；辅导性的」
由动词加名词后缀构成，义为「补救；修复；治理」
由本词加动词后缀构成，义为「补救；修复；治理」
由本词加后缀构成，义为「可补救的；可治疗的」
由本词加后缀构成，义为「无法补救的；无可救药的」

senses.title: A treatment for an illness
senses.titleCN: 治病的方法：药物或疗法
senses.definition: a medicine or treatment that cures or relieves a disease or symptom
senses.definitionCN: 治愈或缓解疾病、症状的药物或疗法
senses.example: Honey and lemon are a traditional remedy for a sore throat.
senses.exampleCN: 蜂蜜和柠檬是缓解喉咙痛的传统疗法。
senses.why: Latin mederi meant to heal, and re- adds the idea of bringing the body back; a remedy is the thing that sets a sick body back where it belongs.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 mederi 意为「医治」，re- 带「回到」的意思；remedy 就是把病中的身体带回正轨的那件东西。

senses.title: A solution to a problem
senses.definition: a means of correcting or improving a bad situation, especially a practical one
senses.definitionCN: 纠正或改善糟糕局面的手段，尤指切实可行的办法
senses.example: The city is looking for a remedy for its chronic traffic jams.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市正在寻找解决长期交通拥堵的办法。
senses.why: A broken situation is treated like a sick body: find the measure that restores it, and that measure is the remedy.
senses.whyCN: 坏掉的局面被当作病中的身体来对待：找到让它恢复的措施，这项措施就是 remedy。

senses.title: Legal relief
senses.definition: a legal means of obtaining compensation or correcting a wrong, such as damages or an injunction
senses.definitionCN: 获得赔偿或纠正不公的法律手段，如损害赔偿或禁令
senses.example: The tenants sought a legal remedy after the landlord ignored the repairs.
senses.exampleCN: 房东无视维修要求后，租户寻求法律救济。
senses.why: Law borrowed the medical image: a wrong is an injury, and the court offers the measure that repairs it.
senses.whyCN: 法律借用了医学的比喻：不法行为是一种伤害，法院提供的正是修复它的措施。

senses.title: To cure or relieve
senses.definition: to cure, relieve, or treat a disease, symptom, or physical problem
senses.definitionCN: 治愈、缓解或治疗疾病、症状或身体问题
senses.example: The doctor could not remedy the infection with the usual antibiotics.
senses.exampleCN: 医生无法用常用抗生素治好这处感染。
senses.why: The verb turns the noun into action: applying the healing measure to the body.
senses.whyCN: 动词把名词变成动作：把医治的措施施加到身体上。

senses.title: To correct a bad situation
senses.definition: to correct or improve a situation, system, or condition that is wrong or unsatisfactory
senses.definitionCN: 纠正或改善错误、不理想的情况、制度或状况
senses.example: The new manager remedied the worst flaws in the scheduling system.
senses.exampleCN: 新经理纠正了排班系统中最严重的缺陷。
senses.why: If a problem is a disease of a system, remedying it is the treatment that brings the system back to working order.
senses.whyCN: 如果问题是系统的疾病，那么 remedy 就是让系统恢复运转的治疗。

senses.title: To make up for harm or loss
senses.definition: to compensate for damage, loss, or a defect, often by repairing or balancing it
senses.definitionCN: 补偿损害、损失或缺陷，常通过修复或衡平来实现
senses.example: The company remedied the damage by rebuilding the flooded warehouse.
senses.exampleCN: 公司通过重建被淹的仓库来弥补损失。
senses.why: The measure is applied after the harm: what was taken away is put back, as far as it can be.
senses.whyCN: 措施在伤害之后才施加：被拿走的东西尽可能被放回去。

senses.title: A household or herbal preparation
senses.definition: a simple preparation, often made at home from plants or common ingredients, used to treat minor ailments
senses.definitionCN: 常在家中用植物或常见材料调制的简易制剂，用于治疗小病
senses.example: Her grandmother's remedy for a cough was warm milk with crushed garlic.
senses.exampleCN: 她祖母治咳嗽的偏方是热牛奶加捣碎的大蒜。
senses.why: This is the noun at its most concrete: the healing measure exists as something you can hold, mix, and take.
senses.whyCN: 这是名词最具体的用法：医治的措施成了能拿在手里、能调制、能服用的东西。

senses.title: Beyond remedy: past repair
senses.titleCN: 无可补救：超出修复范围
senses.definition: in the phrase beyond remedy, in a state that can no longer be cured or repaired
senses.definitionCN: 用于短语 beyond remedy，表示已无法治愈或修复的状态
senses.example: By the time the leak was found, the old manuscript was beyond remedy.
senses.exampleCN: 发现漏水时，那份旧手稿已经无法补救了。
senses.why: The measure has a reach; once the damage passes that reach, no treatment can bring it back.
senses.whyCN: 措施有其能够触及的范围；一旦损害超出这个范围，任何治疗都无法把它带回来。

intro.en: Remedy comes from Latin through Old French, and the whole family gathers around one healing verb.
intro.cn: remedy 经由古法语来自拉丁语，整个词族都围绕一个表示「医治」的动词聚集。

items.en: *med- is generally reconstructed as 'to measure, take appropriate measures'. The deeper origin of this root is source uncertain.
items.cn: 一般认为原始印欧语 *med- 表示「衡量、采取适当的措施」；这个更早的来源不确定。

items.en: The verb mederi meant 'to heal, cure', and it also produced medicus 'physician' and medicina 'medicine'.
items.cn: 动词 mederi 意为「医治、治愈」，它还生出 medicus「医生」与 medicina「药物」。

items.en: Re plus mederi formed remedium, 'a cure, medicine, antidote; a means of correction'. The re- has been explained both as 'back, again' and as an intensifier, and the sources do not fully agree.
items.cn: re- 与 mederi 构成 remedium，意为「药剂、解药、补救手段」。关于 re- 是「回、再」还是加强语气，各家解释并不完全一致。

items.en: Old French remedie carried the word into English with the medical and the corrective senses already joined.
items.cn: 古法语 remedie 把这个词带入英语，医学义与纠正义当时已经并存。

items.en: The noun is recorded from about 1200; the verb appears in the fifteenth century. Exact first dates are uncertain.
items.cn: 名词约自 1200 年有记录；动词见于十五世纪。确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: Legal and everyday branches grew apart: courts speak of a remedy for a wrong, while households speak of a home remedy.
items.cn: 法律义与日常义逐渐分开：法庭谈对不法行为的救济，家庭则谈家常偏方。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words built on the same healing root; the near-meaning group gathers cures, treatments and general solutions with different reach.
note.cn: 形近组收同一「医治」词根构成的一族词；近义组收治愈、治疗与一般性解决办法，彼此适用范围不同。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning corrective, therapeutic, or intended to improve a skill that is weak.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「补救的、治疗上的、辅导性的」，用于改善薄弱的技能。

entries.definition: The noun for the act of correcting, repairing, or cleaning up damage.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「补救、修复、治理」，指纠正或清理损害的行为。

entries.definition: The verb meaning to correct or clean up damage, especially in law or environmental work.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「补救、修复、治理」，多用于法律或环境治理。

entries.definition: A mixture of things, especially songs or styles; it merely looks similar and comes from another root.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「混杂物、杂曲」，尤其指歌曲或风格的混合；只是拼写相近，词源不同。

entries.definition: Without any cure or means of repair; formed directly from remedy plus the suffix -less.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「无法补救的、无可救药的」，由本词加后缀 -less 直接构成。

entries.definition: To make a disease or illness go away; stronger and more strictly medical than remedy.
entries.definitionCN: 动词或名词，义为「治愈、疗法」，比 remedy 更强调病痛消失，医学色彩更强。

entries.definition: Medical care given for an illness; broader than remedy and does not promise a cure.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「治疗、疗程」，范围比 remedy 更宽，不保证治愈。

entries.definition: A substance that counteracts poison or a harmful effect; a narrower medical term.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「解毒剂、对抗手段」，专指抵消毒物或有害影响的物质，医学范围更窄。

entries.definition: An answer to a problem; general and non-medical, with no image of healing.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「解决办法、答案」，属一般用语，不带「医治」的比喻。

entries.definition: To correct or compensate for a wrong, especially in law; formal in tone.
entries.definitionCN: 动词或名词，义为「纠正、补偿」，多用于法律语境，语气正式。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin root and the common phrases the word actually appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些记忆钩子使用真实的拉丁词根，以及这个词实际出现的常见搭配。

normal.en: mederi is to heal: remedy is the healing measure brought back to the body.
normal.cn: mederi 是「医治」：remedy 就是被带回到身体上的医治措施。

normal.en: The same root gives medicine, medical and medic; all of them are about healing.
normal.cn: 同一词根还给出 medicine、medical、medic，它们都与医治有关。

normal.en: A home remedy is a household preparation, not a professional prescription.
normal.cn: home remedy 是家常制剂，不是专业处方。

normal.en: Law calls compensation for a wrong a legal remedy.
normal.cn: 法律把对不法行为的补偿称为 legal remedy。

normal.en: Beyond remedy means past the point where any repair can still work.
normal.cn: beyond remedy 意为已经过了任何修复都能起作用的程度。

abstract.en: Picture a small bottle beside a tilted scale: the illness is the tilt, and the remedy is the weight that brings the beam level again.
abstract.cn: 想象一只小瓶放在倾斜的天平旁：疾病是那点倾斜，remedy 是让横梁重新水平的砝码。

abstract.en: The same bottle can be a law, a policy or a repair: wherever something is out of balance, a remedy is the measure that restores it.
abstract.cn: 同一只瓶子也可以是一条法律、一项政策或一次维修：凡是失衡之处，remedy 就是让它恢复的措施。

abstract.en: A remedy does not erase the past; it puts back as much of the balance as can still be recovered.
abstract.cn: 补救不会抹掉过去，它只是把还能挽回的那部分平衡放回去。

examples.en: A warm drink with honey is a common remedy for a scratchy throat.
examples.cn: 加蜂蜜的热饮是缓解喉咙发痒的常见办法。

examples.en: The committee proposed three remedies for the housing shortage.
examples.cn: 委员会提出了三项解决住房短缺的办法。

examples.en: Engineers remedied the vibration problem before the bridge reopened.
examples.cn: 工程师在桥梁重新开放前解决了振动问题。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞米迪」——米袋一放，病床回正：补救、治疗

root: 拉丁语 remedium「药剂、补救手段」由 re-「回、再」+ mederi「医治」构成；mederi 又生出 medicus「医生」与 medicina「药物」。原始印欧语 *med-「衡量、采取适当措施」一般认为成立，更早来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of remedy all apply one measure to something out of balance: a body, a problem, a legal wrong, a damaged system, a household ailment, or a state past repair.
sensesIntro.cn: remedy 的八个义项都在把同一项「措施」用到失衡的对象上：身体、问题、法律上的不公、受损的系统、家常小病，或已无法修复的状态。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small bottle of medicine is placed beside a tilted scale, and the scale returns to level.
core.cn: 核心意象：一小瓶药放在倾斜的天平旁，天平重新回到水平。

branches.en: THE BODY: a disease is an imbalance, and the remedy is the measure that treats it.
branches.cn: 身体线：疾病是失衡，remedy 是医治它的措施。

branches.en: THE SYSTEM: a problem, a flawed arrangement or a loss is corrected by the same measure applied outside the body.
branches.cn: 系统线：问题、有缺陷的安排或损失，由同一项措施在身体之外加以纠正。

branches.en: THE COURT: law treats a wrong as an injury and offers a remedy to repair it.
branches.cn: 法庭线：法律把不法行为当作伤害，并提供救济来修复它。

branches.en: THE ACT: the verb names applying the healing measure, not the bottle itself.
branches.cn: 动作线：动词指的是施加医治措施，而不是那只瓶子本身。

branches.en: THE EXTREMES: a household preparation is the measure at its most concrete, while beyond remedy marks the end of its reach.
branches.cn: 两端线：家常制剂是措施最具体的一端，beyond remedy 则标出它触及范围的尽头。

intro.en: Remedy is built from a Latin prefix and a Latin healing root; English adds ordinary suffixes to make the family.
intro.cn: remedy 由拉丁语前缀与表示「医治」的拉丁词根构成；英语再普通后缀扩展出这一词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin mederi, medicus, medicina and remedium are all recorded, so only the deeper Indo-European root is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 mederi、medicus、medicina 与 remedium 均有文献记录，只有更早的印欧词根属于重构形式。

items.example: The prefix suggests a return to a former state.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀暗示回到从前的状态。

items.example: The verb is the healing root of the family.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词是这一词族的「医治」词根。

items.meaning: a cure, remedy, means of correction
items.example: The noun joined the prefix and the healing root.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词把前缀与「医治」词根合在一起。
